patch_description: Restructured into a clean three-stage pipeline (builder classes separated from optimization stages): (1) diverse structured/structured/perturbed start pool, (2) annealed soft-min L-BFGS refinement, (3) SLSQP polish maximizing t subject to d²ᵢⱼ ≤ 1 and d²ᵢⱼ ≥ t² applied to the top-3 candidates with increasing symmetry-breaking perturbation scales. Removes dead/incorrect gradient code, uses only verified analytic Jacobians filled per-pair, adds final Nelder-Mead polish on the true ratio. All logic is modularized into small functions with a single `min_max_dist_dim3_14` entry point.
